title: Human PSC-based Modeling of Pulmonary Fibrosis Identifies p300/CBP Inhibition as a Suppressor of Alveolar Transitional Cell State [epithelial]
overall_design: Alveolar organoids composed of SPC-GFP reporter iPSC line (B2-3)-derived alveolar epithelial cells and human fetal lung fibroblasts (HFLFs) were treated with DMSO or BLM for 3 days, followed by an additional 3-day incubation with or without compounds. For gene expression profile analysis, epithelial cells were isolated from the organoids through magnetic activated cell sorting (MACS) using anti-EpCAM antibody.
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: SPC_Epithelial_BLM_1
characteristics_ch1: cell type: iPSC-derived alveolar epithelial cells
treatment_protocol_ch1: Alveolar organoids were treated with DMSO or BLM from day 11 to day14, followed by the removal of BLM and an additional 3-day incubation with or without compounds.
growth_protocol_ch1: Lung progenitor cells were derived from iPSCs and subsequently cocultured with HFLFs to promote the generation of SPC+ cells. SPC+ cell-derived alveolar organoids were further passaged and maintained in DCIK medium. DCIK medium: Ham's F12 (Fujifilm Wako, 087-08335) containing 50 nM dexamethasone, 100 μM 8-Br-cAMP, 100 μM 3-isobutyl-1-methylxanthine, 10 ng/mL KGF, 1% B-27 supplement, 0.25% BSA (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 15260-037), 15 mM HEPES (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 17557-94), 0.8 mM CaCl2, 0.1% ITS premix (Corning), and 50 U/mL Penicillin/Streptomycin.
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted using RNeasy micro (Qiagen).

Library preparation was performed using an Illumina Stranded Total RNA Prep, Ligation with Ribo-Zero Plus kit (Cat# 20040525, Illumina) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The constructed libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NextSeq 2000 with the paired-end mode.
data_processing: Illumina RTA version 3.10.30 and  bcl2fastq version 2.20 were used for basecalling and fastq generation, respectively.

Adapter sequences and low-quality bases were trimmed from the raw reads by cutadapt v4.1. The trimmed reads were mapped to the human reference genome sequences (hg38) using STAR v2.7.10a with the GENCODE (release 36, GRCh38.p13) gtf file.

The uniquely and properly mapped reads were used for further analysis. Raw read counts were calculated using htseq-count v2.0.2 with the GENCODE gtf file. Gene expression levels were determined as transcripts per million (TPM).
Assembly: hg38
Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files incude count values and TPM for each sample.
